stem: A pharmacy corrects repeated product-selection errors but never examines shelving, staffing, or workflow. Which CQI duty remains unmet?

choices.text: Close the event after correcting the individual prescription.
Examine only whether the pharmacist violated a rule.
Wait for the Board to prescribe a corrective action.
Analyze causes and system factors, then use the findings to improve the process.
Replace cause analysis with annual personnel education.
